01 — About

From blueprints to brand systems

I'm a Visual & Motion Graphics Designer based in Riyadh. I started out with a Bachelor's degree in Architecture Engineering, which is where my eye for structure, proportion, and spatial balance comes from — I bring that same discipline into every logo, layout, and animation I design today.

In 2024 I completed a diploma in Visual Design & Motion Graphics at Anas Academy for Digital Visual Arts, London, and have since worked as a freelance designer building complete brand systems — from identity and packaging to social content and short-form motion graphics.

My most recent body of work is for Kids Space, a center for children interested in astronomy and science, where I designed the full identity system shown in the case study below.
